story_theme_en: Lily and Book are saving money for a camping trip. Lily saved 28,400 baht and Book saved 36,200 baht. They want to know how much they have together. If they buy a tent for 24,800 baht, how much money will they have left?
helper_tip_en: When adding multi-digit numbers, line up digits in their correct columns first. Then add from right to left. If the result is greater than 9, carry to the next column.
think_story_en: Addition: Lily has 28,400 + Book has 36,200 = Together 64,600 baht. Subtraction: They have 64,600 minus tent cost 24,800 = They have 39,800 baht left.

visual_blocks.title: Try It!
visual_blocks.question: A mango farm harvested 37,500 mangoes. They sold 18,600 mangoes. How many mangoes are left?

data.question: A mango farm harvested 37,500 mangoes. They sold 18,600 mangoes. How many mangoes are left?

explanation_steps_en: When adding or subtracting numbers up to 100,000, always line up digits in their correct columns first.
Draw a column divider line so ones line up with ones, tens with tens, and so on.
Add or subtract one column at a time from right to left: ones → tens → hundreds → thousands → ten-thousands.
When adding, if the result is greater than 9, carry the extra digit to the next column.
When subtracting, if the bottom digit is larger than the top digit, borrow from the next column.
Check your answer by doing the opposite operation: addition check with subtraction, subtraction check with addition.

worked_examples_en.question_en: Ai has 32,700 baht and receives 25,600 baht more. How much does Ai have in total?
There were 72,800 students. 41,500 left. How many students are left?

common_mistakes_en: Writing digits in the wrong columns, especially with numbers that have different numbers of digits.
Forgetting to carry when addition exceeds 9, or forgetting to borrow when the bottom digit is larger.
Confusing addition and subtraction in multi-step word problems.
hints_en: Draw a column divider line before you start: |Ten-thousands|Thousands|Hundreds|Tens|Ones|
Work from right to left. If you get more than 9, carry to the next column.
Check your answer by doing the opposite operation.

test_bank_en.q: Pim has 36,500 baht and Nam has 28,900 baht. How much do they have together?
A rice field produced 58,600 kg of rice. 24,700 kg were sold. How much rice is left?
A water tank has 75,000 liters of water. 38,500 liters are used. How much water remains?
A theater has 92,700 seats. 47,300 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
Tai saved 41,800 baht and Moo saved 33,700 baht. How much did they save together?
A bus has 86,400 passengers. 39,200 get off at the first stop and 28,900 get off at the second stop. How many are still on the bus?
A festival sold 54,300 tickets on the first day and 38,900 tickets on the second day. How many tickets in total?
A farmer harvested 67,800 kg of corn. After selling some, 29,400 kg remained. How much corn was sold?

explanation_en: Addition and subtraction up to 100,000 follow the same column method as smaller numbers. Always align digits by place value, work right to left, and remember to carry or borrow when needed. Check by reversing the operation.
